author: (A. d'Orbigny, 1841)

note.en: A barrel-shaped bubble snail of about 3 mm, known here from two specimens taken at 8 m off Punta Cahuita and 12 m east of Puerto Vargas.
note.es: Una babosa burbuja en forma de barril de unos 3 mm, conocida aquí por dos ejemplares tomados a 8 m frente a Punta Cahuita y a 12 m al este de Puerto Vargas.

evidence: GBIF: 2 preserved specimens in the region (INBio Atta collection, 1998 and 2001)
WoRMS lists it for the Costa Rican Caribbean

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records (INBio Atta specimen collection), Gandoca to Limón

recWhy: Recorded: GBIF: 2 preserved specimens in the region (INBio Atta collection, 1998 and 2001).

marks.en: Tiny cylindrical, white barrel-shaped shell with fine spiral grooves.
marks.es: Concha diminuta, blanca, cilíndrica en forma de barril con finos surcos espirales.
